entities.name: Nitro aryl Bpin
observations: Contains an aromatic nitro group, an existing aniline, methyl, and aryl pinacol boronate (Bpin).

entities.name: Diamino aryl Bpin
observations: Product retains methyl, existing aniline, and Bpin groups while replacing Ar-NO2 with Ar-NH2.

entities.name: Aryl nitro reduction
observations: Net transformation is selective reduction of an aromatic nitro group to an amino group: Ar-NO2 -> Ar-NH2.
The exact reaction record explicitly includes methanol, but does not expose reducing reagent, catalyst, temperature, time, or yield.

entities.name: Methanol solvent
observations: Methanol is explicitly present as a component in an exact core-reactant analog for the nitro-to-aniline conversion.

entities.name: Bpin-compatible reduction options
observations: Likely reagent classes include H2/Pd-C, H2/PtO2, H2/Raney Ni, ammonium formate/Pd-C, Fe/NH4Cl, and SnCl2/HCl.

Mild catalytic or transfer-hydrogenation conditions are preferable because aryl Bpin can undergo protodeboronation; these recommendations are chemical interpretation rather than conditions established by the exact record.
